title: UI风格#177 - Bauhaus Modern (包豪斯现代)
description: 创建第177种UI风格：包豪斯现代风格 - 基础设计学院风格、几何原色、功能主义。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Modern style When color palette Then features primary red, blue, yellow with black and white
Given Bauhaus Modern style When typography Then uses geometric sans: Futura, Avant Garde, or Circular
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Futura PT (headings/body, 300-700 weights), DM Mono (stats/accents) - geometric Bauhaus typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Modern style When layout Then basic geometric shapes, grid composition, functional layout
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: 8px tricolor border (red/blue/yellow), geometric circle decorations, 3px black borders, grid-based layout, functional composition

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Modern style When UI elements Then circle, square, triangle forms, primary color accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: □○△◇ geometric icons on cards, colored accent shapes (red square, blue circle, yellow hollow, black diamond), primary color hover states

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Modern UI When functional Then includes form chat, basic agents, function stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Function/Form chat header, 4 basic agents (FORM-01, BASIC-02, GRID-03, SHAPE-04) with Grid/Func/Form/Comp/Elem/Sync stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Modern UI When copy Then uses functional: 'Form', 'Function', 'Basic', 'Grid'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'FORM. FUNCTION. BASIC.', tagline '// fundamental design principles //', button 'FORM', greeting 'FORM_FOLLOWS_FUNCTION. What shall we create today?', nav '□ Form'/'○ Function'/'△ Basic'/'◇ Grid'
